info.title: catalogue-svc
info.description: Brands, categories, shared products and variants, the per-product seller whitelist, and the seller product request workflow. Products belong to no seller; price, tax and stock are in inventory-svc per (variant, seller). No service-level auth: the gateway authenticates requests.

put.summary: Set the sellers allowed to sell a product: the listed ones become ENABLED, the others DISABLED. Returns every seller listed for the product.

post.summary: File a request to sell a shared product at the seller's own price. The seller must be active and on the product's whitelist.

403.description: Not permitted: the seller is suspended or is not on the product's whitelist

get.summary: Get a request with its items

put.summary: Revise and resubmit a DRAFT or REJECTED request. The seller and product cannot change.

403.description: Not permitted: the seller is suspended or is not on the product's whitelist

409.description: The request's status does not allow this

delete.summary: Soft-delete a request that is not APPROVED

409.description: The request's status does not allow this

put.summary: Approve or reject (admin). Approving archives the seller's previous approved request for the product and publishes the change event; approving an already-approved request re-sends the event.

403.description: Not permitted: the seller is suspended or is not on the product's whitelist

409.description: The request's status does not allow this

put.summary: Show or hide an APPROVED request's live offer, and publish the change event

409.description: The request's status does not allow this

put.summary: Apply approved or archived requests whose live state has not reached inventory-svc. A scheduler calls this regularly; repeating it is safe. 500 if inventory-svc is still unreachable.

mrp.description: The seller's list price; becomes the offer's mrp in inventory-svc

discount.description: An amount off mrp, 0 to mrp

synced.description: False while an APPROVED or ARCHIVED request has a change inventory-svc has not seen
